messages:
tara: Heads-up — QA hit a bunch of 400/413s on /v1/embeddings when clients send mixed-dim batches. Stack traces show splitter rejecting payloads. Anyone else seen this?

kevin: yep saw a spike in errors around 08:12. looks like preflight rejects arrays with different vector lengths. behaviour currently: we return 413 'request entity too large' or a validation error.

jon: mixed dims are common from client-side libs that concat multiple models' outputs. current router doesn't split mixed dims automatically, right? it's a policy decision.

maya: correct — splitter used to assume uniform dims. we can either enforce in SDK/console (preflight) or do server-side split+fanout. tradeoffs: extra copies, more per-request cost counting.

kevin: proposal: if all dims in batch are in SUPPORTED_DIMS set, accept and server-split into per-dim sub-batches. Add metadata headers so billing/telemetry attribute back to original request. e.g. `X-Embed-Orig-Count`, `X-Embed-Split-Ids`

tara: that sounds user-friendly. questions: how does quota get charged? if we split into 3 calls, is client charged 3x? Admins will freak if suddenly their usage doubles.

jon: we should charge by original logical item count, not by internal fanout. Implementation: record a single composite billing event with original_count and sum(token_estimate) for charge calc. router would emit a single metric `embed.request.composite_count` and the per-shard calls emit `embed.shard.latency` for perf telemetry.

maya: ok but console quota UI needs to reflect that too. Right now console shows per-endpoint token usage (derived from raw calls). We must add mapping table: composite_request_id -> constituent_shard_calls, aggregate in the console pipeline.

kevin: telemetry + tracing idea: tag all shard RPCs with `orig_request_id` and `orig_batch_size`. sample 1% of requests for full trace and log `split_plan` so we can debug perf regressions.

tara: what about latency SLO? splitting increases tail latency sometimes. we need to estimate: worst-case p95 extra latency = remote fanout + join time. Can we do async fanout with early partial responses? Not for embeddings endpoint — clients expect full array.

jon: we can parallelize shards across workers and join. p50 shouldn't change much, p95 could increase if one shard is slow. Add circuit-breaker: if shard count > N or estimated memory > M, fallback to rejecting and instruct client to split.

maya: console UX: add a preflight check in the route editor and SDK that warns: "Mixed-dimension batch detected — server will split into N sub-batches; estimated extra latency X ms; billing will be based on original item count." Show a toggle to disable server-split (strict mode).

kevin: rollout plan: behind feature flag `embeds-mix-split-v2`. Canary on dedicated infra first, monitor `embed.error_rate`, `embed.composite_charge_delta`, `embed.p95_latency`. Gradual % rollout over 7 days.

tara: we also need migration notes for customers with quota alerts — surface a bump preview in console when feature is opt-in. admins should opt-in if they accept composite billing.

jon: telemetry additions: histogram metric `embed.shards.per_request` and `embed.shard.size_bytes` + gauge `embed.pending_join_count`. Alerts: >2x increase in composite charges for any org in 24h.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for embeds-mix-split-v2 on dedicated-zone-3 at 2025-06-10T08:45Z (job #4521).

maya: action items: (1) kevin implement server-split + header tags (2) jon add composite billing event and telemetry (3) tar a console preflight UI + warning copy (4) add feature flag and canary dashboard. I'll file infra tickets.

kevin: I'll open PR for splitter and add tests for size accounting + orig_id propagation.

jon: I'll spec the billing event JSON and dashboard panels.

tara: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 to review trace samples and canary metrics. :thumbsup:
